recorded.prompt:q-skip:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-skip:a: 'Defer 2028's two circuits... by one year and nothing is saved.'
recorded.prompt:q-skip:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-skip:b: In the page's example the deferred miles all land on the next year (2029: 153), not spread evenly.
recorded.prompt:q-skip:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-skip:d: 'Deferring vegetation work moves cost and risk into later years; it does not remove them.'
recorded.prompt:q-crews:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-crews:b: 'Crews are not shared between fleets: a tree crew does not rebuild towers.' The row is per program.
recorded.prompt:q-crews:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-crews:c: Alternative rows are 'one at-most-one row per group of options for the same asset'. A crew limit is a row per program and year.
recorded.prompt:q-crews:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-crews:d: 'It binds a fleet on its own even when the money is there.'
recorded.prompt:q-regulators:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-regulators:a: 'transmission projects may be reviewed by a different regulator from the rest of the portfolio.'
recorded.prompt:q-regulators:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-regulators:b: N-1 is reliability planning, not a cost threshold. Distribution: 'the state commission regulates it'.
recorded.prompt:q-regulators:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-regulators:c: This reverses the page. The state regulates distribution, and FERC sets transmission rates. NERC writes reliability standards and does not review cost.
